subject: Slate Systems — MAP cadence / pricing gating triage
messages:
From: Alejandra Ruiz <procurement@slate-systems.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Brenner <cto@slate-systems.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: MAP & pricing runway for Slate evaluation

Diego,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our product team is positive about Redwood's latency profile and the ops team flagged the KV cache behavior as promising. Procurement and finance would like to align on a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out: pricing bands for committed spend, any evaluation credits, timeline to contract signature, and the minimal compliance evidence we'll need (SOC2 report, data retention SLA).

High-level asks from our side:
- Preliminary discount guidance for an initial 6-month committed spend (~$25k-$40k) — procurement prefers a single-band commitment table.
- Any evaluation credits you can extend during the PoC period.
- Typical internal approval path and how quickly Redwood can sign an MSA + SOW.
- Confirmation you can meet our audit request for SOC2 evidence and log retention details.

We would like to target a commercial decision by Oct 21 to align with our fiscal quarter close — can Redwood support that cadence?

I've attached our RFP checklist for reference. Happy to set a short MAP checkpoint each week to keep momentum.

Alejandra Ruiz
Head of Procurement, Slate Systems
Attachment: RFP_requirements.docx
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <procurement@slate-systems.com>
Cc: Tom Brenner <cto@slate-systems.com>, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & pricing runway for Slate evaluation

Alejandra — thanks for the clear asks and the RFP. We're happy to run a weekly MAP checkpoint and align on the items you listed. Proposed next steps below and I've attached a first-pass MAP workbook.

Proposed MAP cadence (weekly checkpoint):
- Week 1 (Sep 27): kickoff + pricing bands and evaluation credit proposal
- Week 2 (Oct 4): procurement terms + SSO/KMS technical deep-dive (ops + security)
- Week 3 (Oct 11): contract review + legal redlines
- Week 4 (Oct 18): final sign-off prep (MSA/SOW ready)

Preliminary commercial options (quick view):
- Commit band A: $25k over 6 months -> 15% discount off list pricing
- Commit band B: $35k over 6 months -> 20% discount off list pricing
- Commit band C: $50k+ -> 25% discount and 90-day accelerated support SLA

Evaluation credits: proposing $8k in platform credits during the 30-day PoC (applied after first invoice).

Open items that need internal signoffs: finance approval on credit size and discount authority for Band B/C; legal timing on MSA turnaround.

Can we block Sep 27 at 10:00am PT for the first MAP checkpoint? I've included Vivek, Marissa, and Neha to help with approvals and finance gating.

Attachment: Slate_MAP_v0.1.xlsx

— Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Alejandra Ruiz <procurement@slate-systems.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Brenner <cto@slate-systems.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: MAP & pricing runway for Slate evaluation

Diego — Sep 27 10:00am PT works for us. We'll include legal and our security lead on the invite. Thanks for the quick draft — we'll review the MAP workbook prior to the call.

Alejandra
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: MAP & pricing runway for Slate evaluation — internal triage

Team — forwarding Slate's ask. Key items to triage before Monday's prep:
1) Discount authority: Alejandra asked for a clear band table and hinted at 25% being a deal-breaker to meet their FY close. Who has final sign-off on >20%?
2) Credits: proposed $8k. Finance impact/approval needed. Are credits bill-backable against the first invoice?
3) Technical evidence: security wants SOC2 report and log retention details. Can we drop a hosted SOC2 report link and an ops runbook?
4) Contract cadence: legal turnaround time — how long to finalize a standard MSA + SOW once terms are agreed?

Suggested immediate responses before the Sep 27 checkpoint:
- Confirm maximum discount we can offer without escalating to sales leadership (quick yes/no).
- Approve/deny $8k credit and whether we can apply it as a pre-invoice credit.
- Provide links to SOC2 and logs docs I can share.

I've attached my proposed draft proposal to use as a baseline for the call. I'll run the MAP workbook live on the call and capture action items.

Attachment: draft_proposal.pdf

— Diego
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: diego.fernandez@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: MAP & pricing runway for Slate evaluation — internal triage

Diego / team — quick guidance from pricing/leadership:
- Discount authority: up to 20% can be approved by pricing without CFO escalation. Anything >20% requires formal escalation to finance leadership and a clear commit (>= $50k ARR equivalent) and justified strategic rationale.
- Credits: approve up to $10k in evaluation credits for strategic, timeboxed PoCs. Credits should be issued as a one-time invoice credit applied to first invoice and recorded as a sales credit in the deal record. Finance (Neha) will confirm the accounting treatment.
- SOC2 / logs: engineering can provide the hosted SOC2 report link and a short ops note on retention/purge windows. Marissa — please surface the standard evidence packet.

Action items I own:
- Approve up to 20% for Band B if they commit to $35k over 6 months.
- Quick review of proposed SLA addendum if they ask for accelerated support.

If Slate presses for 25%, loop me and I'll present to CFO; we'll need a clear justification (strategic partner status or expanded rollout).

— Vivek
From: diego.fernandez@redwood.com <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alejandra Ruiz <procurement@slate-systems.com>, Tom Brenner <cto@slate-systems.com>
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Slate MAP checkpoint (notes + agreed gating) — Sep 27 meeting summary

Alejandra / Tom — thanks for the MAP checkpoint on Sep 27. Below is a short readout and the mutual action items we captured on the call.

Meeting summary (Sep 27)
- Attendees: Alejandra Ruiz (Slate, procurement), Tom Brenner (Slate, CTO), Diego Fernandez (Redwood AE), Vivek Kulkarni (Redwood), Marissa Cole (Redwood, Finance), Neha Kapoor (Redwood, Accounting)
- Purpose: finalize pricing bands and secure internal approvals to meet Slate's Oct 21 commercial decision timeline.

Decisions & commercial gating
- Agreed commercial banding:
  - Band A: $25k commit, 6 months -> 15% discount
  - Band B: $35k commit, 6 months -> 20% discount (approved by Redwood pricing)
  - Band C: $50k+ commit -> 25% discount (requires CFO escalation)
- Evaluation credits: Redwood to issue $8k evaluation credit applied to first invoice (approved).
- Credit accounting: Credits will appear as a one-time invoice credit; Neha to confirm GL coding and contract note.
- Security evidence: Redwood provided hosted SOC2 link and ops notes; Slate follow-up with security lead scheduled Oct 4 deep-dive.
- Contract timeline: Legal committed to a 5-business day turnaround on standard MSA once final commercial terms are agreed; SOW to be attached within the same cycle.

Action items (owners & ETA)
- Diego: circulate final MAP + revised MAP workbook with agreed banding and credit detail by Sep 30 (Attachment: Slate_MAP_v0.1.xlsx).
- Neha: confirm accounting treatment for $8k credit and provide the credit clause language to include in SOW by Oct 1.
- Marissa: surface SOC2 evidence packet and retention note (ops runbook) to share with Slate by Oct 1.
- Vivek: escalate to CFO if Slate requests >20% discount (on demand).
- Tom / Slate: share security contact info for Oct 4 technical deep-dive (by Oct 1).

Next checkpoint: Oct 4 technical + security deep-dive (invite to follow).

Attachments: Slate_MAP_v0.1.xlsx, draft_proposal.pdf, RFP_requirements.docx

If anything above is incorrect or missing, call it out and I'll update the MAP workbook. Looking forward to keeping this moving.

— Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment(s): Slate_MAP_v0.1.xlsx, draft_proposal.pdf, RFP_requirements.docx
